remarks: CUSTOM-BUILT RANCH NESTLED ON 10 ACRES! This exceptional 2334 Sq. Ft. ranch incudes the finished bonus room, home offers quality craftsmanship, impressive amenities, and incredible versatility for the homeowner who needs both luxury and workspace. Featuring 3 bedrooms plus a spectacular 14' x 38' bonus room over the garage all done in maple tongue and groove plank walls and ceiling. This hidden gem is truly one-of-a-kind. The heart of the home is the stunning maple kitchen, crafted by Mennonite craftsmen, featuring cabinetry extending to the ceilings, beautiful quartz countertops, and an enormous center island with breakfast bar. The souring 10' ceilings along with oak hardwood floors throughout the house creates a spacious, warm and inviting atmosphere. Laundry room w/pocket door, stainless steel sink and cabinet storage. The unfinished 14 course basement provides tremendous potential and features radiant-heated floors, oak stairs, plumbing for a full bath and oak staircase to the garage. The attached 3 1/2 car garage is a standout feature with radiant heated floors, auto door-bolt security when doors close, walls are all drywalled. And then there's the OUTDOOR WORKSPACE! The massive 80' x 60' pole barn features a radiant-heated floor, tall overhead doors, complete spray-foam insulation, full bathroom, and a man door. The hydraulic lift will stay.  Another separate building for more separate storage or workspace. Outside enjoy the covered rear patio with brick flooring and peaceful views of the surrounding 10 acres. The driveway combines blacktop from the road, partial stone and concrete in front of garage for functionality and easy access to all areas of the property. A rare opportunity to own this custom-built hidden gem in the Town of LeRoy. Public water and natural gas.
